correctness.rationale: For G=K_n\E(C_n), each induced disconnected 3-set has an isolated vertex whose only two nonneighbors are its cyclic neighbors, so the disconnected triples are exactly cyclic length-3 arcs. Fixed barycentric coordinates are constant on complete reflection orbits; fixed geometric points are therefore represented by orbit collections with a face-union, not by only original fixed vertices. Folding a cycle gives a path on m=(n+f)/2 orbit vertices, and projected arc minimal edges are the two end pairs and interior triples starting j=1,...,m-4. Writing Y_m as a union of the complement simplex of {0,1} with the cone of all other complement facets, the intersection is exactly Y_{m-2} after relabeling; both pieces contractible and Y_3,Y_4 are homotopy S^0. Therefore Y_m is a suspension of Y_{m-2} for every m>=5, giving the sphere dimension and integral homology by induction. Independent quotient-graph/reflection-arc enumeration for all 656 pairs (n,a) with 5<=n<=36 confirmed the exact minimal-edge model, with both even-axis types. This finite check is only corroboration of the unrestricted proof.
residual_risks: Historical and unindexed geometric reflection-fixed calculations could cover an equivalent formulation; search is not proof of priority.
The homeomorphism is with explicit Y_m; the identification with a sphere is only homotopy equivalence and is not an equivariant system for arbitrary subgroups.

evidence: Kim–Kim Section 3 classifies ordinary noncover complexes; Deshpande–Roy–Sawant Theorem 4.12 establishes vertex decomposability of Sigma_r(C_n complement), whose facets complement CONNECTED triples, not the cut-complex disconnected-triple facets; Chauhan–Shukla addresses ordinary shellability.
broader_coverage.reasoning: None of these stronger-looking general family results implies the individual geometric fixed-point spheres; the underlying complexes and outputs must be distinguished.

value.rationale: Geometric fixed spaces give genuinely finer invariants than ordinary nonequivariant homotopy and character traces. The theorem settles all odd and both even reflection conjugacy types in an infinite cut-complex family; endpoint-shortened tight-path suspension is a reusable structural mechanism, including first nontrivial boundary orders.

final_claim: For every n>=5 and every reflection s_a of the n-cycle, the geometric fixed-point space of the ordinary 3-cut complex of K_n minus C_n is homotopy equivalent to the single sphere S^{floor(((n+f)/2-3)/2)}, f the number of individually fixed graph vertices; the orbit complex is an explicitly endpoint-shortened tight-path noncover complex.
